text:
**The evidence does not establish whether fire caused the 2021 tree-cover loss.** The supplied data identify 81.3 hectares of loss, but include no fire or burn evidence and do not attribute a cause.

Of the loss area, 68.1 hectares were mapped as planted pine forest. That context alone cannot distinguish fire from harvesting or another cause. Fire-detection data or imagery showing burn scars would be needed to investigate further.
